inputs.text: Thursday saw workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations marching in Abuja at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to oppose the reform legislation before the National Assembly. This is no ordinary pushback. It's all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings, with those so-called reforms serving as a front to tighten control over the health sector for their own interests. The official push is just another layer of narrative inversion to paint the resistance as unreasonable and let the real agenda advance unchecked. These tensions are boiling over exactly because people are seeing the pattern of concealed motives at work.
